description:
Move the cargo-ci self-test out of the default suite into a declared gate over the script.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/merged_tree_gate_verification_tests.rs` runs `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh` (622 lines) inside the default suite. The script runs nested cargo builds of six fixture crates (`cargo build` at `:501`, gate runs at `:486`, scenarios at `:606-612`) and takes about 4 s. The test prints `SKIP:` and passes when the script exits 2 for missing git, cargo or jq (`:48-53`). The gate that runs it was registered in `.jit/gates.toml` at planning. `dev/TESTING.md` (`:195`, `:384`) describes where the self-test runs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The registered gate `cargo-ci-selftest` runs `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh`, and its `[gates.inputs]` cover the self-test, the script it exercises and that script's fixtures; its declaration in `.jit/gates.toml` carries `mode` with no `auto` key.
- [hard] REQ-02: `cargo-ci-selftest` fails whenever the self-test exits non-zero, including exit 2 for a missing tool, and passes on the tree with this change.
- [hard] REQ-03: `merged_tree_gate_verification_tests.rs` no longer exists, and the default suite runs no nested cargo build for this self-test.
- [hard] REQ-04: `dev/TESTING.md` describes the self-test as a gate.
title: cargo-ci self-test runs as a declared gate
